recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white-background grid layout featuring two distinct album covers side-by-side, framed by heavy horizontal rules and bold, blocky sans-serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two square image containers
Hierarchy established by oversized top-aligned text
Horizontal rule lines acting as structural dividers
Contrast between the white negative space and the saturated image content

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is the large header text at the top; secondary subjects are the two square album covers centered in the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black sans-serif name at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow: Header -> Horizontal Rule -> Image Grid -> Horizontal Rule -> Footer Text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white margins and gutters create a clinical, organized 1960s-era catalog feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and Red (Holiday imagery within the left frame)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black and white frame containing medium-saturation vintage photographic prints.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing in the header
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard heavy grotesque proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy upright sans-serif for the primary name paired with a slanted, more condensed sans-serif for the descriptive titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the header.
Captures the mid-century Swiss-inspired look of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a clean white canvas with two 4pt black horizontal lines: one near the top and one near the bottom. In the center space between the lines, place two square vintage-style 1960s photographs side-by-side with a small gutter between them. The left photo should feature a holiday wreath; the right photo should feature a man in a suit against a brown curtain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, all-caps sans-serif name in the top section. In the bottom section, add two lines of bold italicized sans-serif text, centered.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal rules perfectly parallel?
Is the header text larger than any other element?
Are the two images perfectly square and aligned?
Is the background pure white without texture?

adjustableVariables: Spacing between the two central images
mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand marks
The specific facial features of the artist
Handwritten text on the internal album art
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not touching the horizontal rules
Verify the images are centered horizontally
Check that the footer text is properly italicized
recipe.reuseFormula: White Background + Heavy Horizontal Rules + (2) Square Images + Bold Sans-Serif Header + Italic Sans-Serif Footer.
